title: Bold Words In String
description: Given an array of keywords words and a string s, wrap every character that belongs to at least one occurrence of any keyword in the tags and . Merge overlapping or adjacent bold ranges so the result uses the fewest valid tag pairs, and return the resulting string. ## Examples ### Example 1 ```text Input: words = ["ab","bc"], s = "aabcd" Output: "aabcd" ``` Explanation: The matches for "ab" and "bc" overlap, so their adjacent ranges are combined into one bold range. ### Example 2 ```text Input: words = ["ab","cb"], s = "aabcd" Output: "aabcd" ``` ## Constraints - 1 <= s.length <= 500 - 0 <= words.length <= 50 - 1 <= words[i].length <= 10 - s and words[i] consist of lowercase English letters.
